name: Nie
source:
You can enjoy many situations with the girl of your taste.

4 stories are available.
Saji and Louise
Marina when escaping with children
Kidnap of Wang Liu M**
Asuka and Hikari

You can choose from the 4 girls from the beginning.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052184.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
选择你喜欢的女孩，体验她在不同情境中的故事。

本作收录四篇：
沙慈与露易丝
带着孩子逃亡时的玛丽娜
王留○遭绑架
明日香与光

从游戏开始便可自由选择四位女孩中的任意一人。
